events.what_it_is: A three-day public Good Foundations pop-up centered on Westman Atelier's Suprême Bio-Complex Liquid Foundation, with shade matching, beauty touch-ups and scheduled special programming.
events.what_is_free: General public access to the pop-up is advertised as free. Special programming includes a September 11 GRWM session, September 12 Shade Match & Spritz, and a September 13 walk club; individual program capacity may be limited.
events.caveats: Current listings describe the overall pop-up as open to the public, while also publishing RSVP links for specific scheduled programs. Those program RSVPs should not be treated as organizer approval for general pop-up access.
events.practical_notes: September 11–13, 11 AM–6 PM at 251 Elizabeth Street. Special programming: GRWM September 11, 4–6 PM; Shade Match & Spritz September 12, 4–6 PM; Walk Club September 13, 10 AM–12 PM.

events.event_name: Ready, Set, Serve: A Tennis Fan Experience
events.address: The Shops at Skyview, 40-24 College Point Blvd, Flushing, NY 11354
events.what_it_is: A public tennis fan experience with an immersive photo booth, US Open finals livestreams, and a September 13 finale with a DJ, drinks and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: The host advertises free tickets for the fan experience. The immersive tennis photo booth is available through September 13, with finals livestreams September 11–13 and additional drinks/giveaways at the September 13 finale.
events.caveats: The official host page offers free tickets. The published finals schedule has different start times by date; giveaways and drinks are specifically promoted for the September 13 finale and are not guaranteed for every attendee.
events.practical_notes: September 11: Women's Doubles Final at 12 PM. September 12: Men's Doubles Final at 12 PM and Women's Singles Final at 4 PM. September 13: Men's Singles Final at 2 PM with DJ, drinks and giveaways.
